status_summary: Two Texas district courts vacated DOL's 2024 white-collar exemption rule on 2024-11-15 and 2024-12-30, and the Fifth Circuit dismissed the related appeals on 2026-05-05 and 2026-05-07. On 2026-05-15 DOL published a technical amendment, effective immediately, removing the vacated text and restoring the 2019 salary levels, including $684 per week for the standard test. The notice says it does not foreclose later rulemaking on part 541. Congressional action on the regular rate and multiweek overtime periods was not researched.

timeline.event: The Fifth Circuit dismissed the appeal in Flint Avenue v. Department of Labor, two days after dismissing the appeal in Texas v. Department of Labor, leaving the district court vacatur of the 2024 rule in place.
timeline.source: Federal Register (DOL notice describing the dismissals)

timeline.event: DOL's Wage and Hour Division published a technical amendment to 29 CFR part 541, effective immediately, carrying out the court judgments that vacated the 2024 rule and restoring the 2019 earnings thresholds ($684 per week standard salary level; $107,432 for highly compensated employees).
